scope: Full-660 H3 flow-inversion stitch corrections before accepted delivery
summary: Seven model windows completed, but stitch attempts v1--v5 were retained as partial evidence while seam 612 and exact background restoration were corrected.
evidence: v1 improved full-video jerk but seam 612 reached a 1.2850867 jerk ratio, above the 1.25 seam bound.
v2 anchored seam 612 to a 1.0438260 ratio but the outside-safety gate remained false.
v3 failed closed with a recorded shape-mismatch traceback rather than publishing an incomplete result.
v4 retained the false outside-safety gate, and v5 exposed 26,536,581 changed pixels outside the declared mask due to faulty indexed restoration semantics.
All failed and partial manifests remain in immutable run directories.
lessons: A smooth overlap is insufficient when one seam exceeds its local gate; a bounded base anchor can repair the isolated transition.
Exact restoration must use a shape-preserving per-pixel selection such as np.where; flattened boolean assignment can either fail or measure the wrong region.
limitations: These stitch attempts are not approved showcase outputs and human review remains false in their manifests.
next_actions: Use shape-preserving exact background and flower restoration, rerun every gate, then inspect contact and seam frames before promotion.
